paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Jesu Khrist sawltak hi ding a sap leh i unaupa Sostheni in,
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Korinth a Pathian saptuam omte, Khrist Jesu a sehtuam siangthoute, misiangthou hi ding a sapte leh gam chih a i Toupa, amau leh eite Toupa, Jesu Khrist min lou tengteng kiang ah;
Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Khrist Jesu a Pathian hehpihna noute kiang a hong kipiak ziak in na tungthu uah Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen gige a;
heading: Kipahthu Genna

paite: bangkim ah thugen peuhmah ah leh theihna chiteng ah, amah ahihhauh in na om uhi.
Huchi in Khrist thu ka theihsak pen noumau ah hihkip in a-om hi.
Huan i Toupa Jesu Khrist kilakna ngak kawm in, khalam thilpiak himhim na tasam kei uhi.
Ama'n i Toupa Jesu Khrist ni chiang a gensiatbei a na omna ding un, atawp pha in hon hihkip behlap ding hi.
A Tapa Jesu Khrist i Toupa toh kithuahna nei ding a nou hon samlutpa, Pathian amuanhuai hi.

Huan unaute aw, na vek un thu kibang na gen ua, na lak ua kikhenna himhim a-omlouhna ding in lungsim mun khat leh ngaihtuah mun khat a diktak a na kizop tinten zawkna ding un Toupa Jesu Khrist min in ka hon ngen ahi.
heading: Saptuam Sung A Kipawlkhenna

paite: Ka unaute aw, na tungtang thu uh, na lak uah kiselna a-om chih Kloi inkuanpihte'n hon hilh uhi.
Hiai ka chihna ahi, nou sung a khat-le-khat in, "Kei Paul pawl ka hi, kei Apollos pawl ka hi, kei Kifas pawl ka hi, kei zaw Khrist pawl ka hi," na chih uh.
Khrist khenzak in a-om a hia? Na sik un Paul kilhden in a-om a hia? Ahihkeileh Paul min in baptis in na om ua hia?
Khrispas leh Gaias lou ngal na lak uah mi kuamah ka hon baptis louh ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen ahi.
Huchi hi keileh zaw mi'n keimah min a baptis na hi uh achi kha ding uhi.
Stephenas inkuanpihte bel ka baptis ngei a, tuate lou zaw midang ka baptis hia ka thei kei.
Khrist in baptis ding in hon sawl kei a, tanchinhoih gen ding in ahon sawl zaw hi; thupil a gen lou in, huchi lou in zaw Khrist kros thilhihtheihna bangmah lou asuaksak kha ding uhi.
Kros thu zaw mangthang lelte a ding in haina ahi ngal a; ei hotdam lelte a ding in bel Pathian thilhihtheihna ahi zaw hi.
heading: Pathian Pilna leh Thilhihtheihna Khrist Ahi

paite: "Mipil' pilna ka hihmang ding a, lemthei' lemtheihna leng ka paikhe ding," chih gelh ahi.
Mipil koi ah ahia? Laigelhmi koi ah ahia? Hiai khovel a selhatmi koi ah ahia? Pathian in khovel pilna haihuai ahi chih atheisak kei a hia?
Pathian pilna ah bel, khovel in apilna zang a Pathian atheihtheih louh nung in thugen haihuai zang a agingtate hotdam akipah lam ahi.
Judate'n chiamtehnate aphut ua, Grikte'n pilna'n azong uh.
Eite'n bel Khrist kilhden thu i gen ua; huai tuh Judate a ding in pukna, Zentelte a ding in haina ahi.
Himahleh Judate leng hi hen aw, Grikte leng hi heh, sapte a ding in zaw Khrist, Pathian thilhihtheihna leh Pathian pilna pen ahi.
Pathian haina mihing sang in apilzaw a, Pathian hatlouhna leng mihing sang in ahatzaw hi.
Unaute aw, ahon sapna ngaihtuah dih ua, salam a mipil tampite, mihat tampite, mihoih pipite, sap ahihlouhdan uh;
himahleh Pathian in mipilte azahlaksak theihna ding in khovel thil haite atel a; huan Pathian in khovel thil hatloute atel a, ahatte azahlaksak theihna ding in;
khovel thil niam leh simmohhuaite, thil omloute tan in Pathian in atel a; thil omte bangmah lou a abawltheihna ding in.
Huchi in Pathian ma ah mi kuamah aki-uangsak thei kei ding uh.
Amah ziak in noute Khrist Jesu ah na om uhi; Pathian in Khrist i pilna, i diktatna, i sianthouna leh i tatna hi ding in abawlta hi,
hichi a gelh ahih bang in, "Asuang peuhmah in Toupa suang hen."
